capabilities: Look up selected words and sentences
Capture words with surrounding sentence context
Save vocabulary as built-in FSRS flashcards
Review cards in recall and context layouts
extras: Requires desktop Obsidian 1.14.4 or later. Data from the old Language Learner plugin is not auto-migrated. Review state is stored as append-only events under LinguaLeafData/review/; sync the whole folder and resolve conflicts before reviewing. Uses ts-fsrs 5.4.1 (MIT).
intentEvidence: This project is derived from Language Learner by the_tree, retains dictionary and Vue panel code
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up words while reading and turn them into spaced-repetition flashcards within the same note.

relations.evidence: This project is derived from Language Learner by the_tree, retains dictionary and Vue panel code

summary: Vocabulary lookup and flashcard tool that reads native Markdown, captures words and sentences with context, and reviews them with a built-in FSRS engine.
